image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image captures the anterior to mid-section of the fish, showing its characteristic black head and front body transitioning into a bright yellow posterior. The eye is visible on the far left edge, and the dorsal and anal fins are partially visible at the top and bottom edges.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is located at the very tip of the snout, which is cut off by the left edge of the frame. It is not visible.
A portion of a large, dark eye with a light rim is clearly visible on the left side of the subject.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible curvature of the dorsal and ventral profiles indicates a deep, laterally compressed body typical of angelfish/butterflyfish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image perfectly displays the diagnostic color pattern: a solid black mask covering the head and anterior body, sharply contrasting with the bright yellow/gold posterior.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin is visible along the top edge, appearing continuous and consistent with the species' anatomy.
The anal fin is visible along the bottom edge, mirroring the dorsal fin's position and texture.
The caudal peduncle and tail are outside the frame to the right; the tail shape cannot be verified.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), which is likely an intentional photographic depth-of-field effect rather than an AI artifact, but it contributes to a slight lack of overall sharpness in the non-subject areas.

The black scales have a slightly uniform, noisy texture that lacks the distinct individual scale definition seen in high-resolution macro photography, though this is subtle and could be due to image compression.

alignment_reasoning: The image exhibits near-perfect conformance to the 'rock beauty' class. All testable checkpoints regarding body shape, fin structure, and the distinctive black-and-gold coloration are present and accurate. Two checkpoints were untestable due to cropping (mouth, tail), but the visible evidence strongly supports the classification without contradiction.
artifact_reasoning: The image is largely artifact-free. Minor issues include a slight graininess/noise in the black pigmentation area and standard depth-of-field blur in the background. There are no structural deformities, melting, or logical inconsistencies.
